prompt: Create a faithful high quality illustrated 2D fighting game sprite atlas, sourced from the attached actual original 2008 Metal Gear Solid 4 PS3 game captures. Transparent RGBA background. Fixed orthographic side/three-quarter game view and constant standing body scale. Every head, hand, foot and costume end fully inside its own cell; generous 35 pixel alpha gutters, 25 pixel outer alpha margins. No text, grid lines, scenery, floor shadows, glow, particles, detached props or extra people. Crisp detailed hand painted game art, original costume proportions and colors under neutral light. Screaming Beauty, original adult MGS4 unarmored form, not an original character. Source adult female face: pale skin, dark lined eyes and black short hair swept up and back in a compact high crest, small pulled back rear section, no long loose hair and no white hair. Fully opaque bronze/olive brown fitted full length original nanotech bodysuit with subtle mottled material, high closed collar, seam across waist, integrated matching brown full gloves and close fitting boots, parallel dark graphite blue-grey lines following outside of shoulders and arms and outside of legs. Entire body clothed from neck to feet, hands gloved; only actual face uncovered. No nudity, exposed abdomen, cleavage, lingerie, wet transparency or sexual posing. Original source shows distress, walking toward opponent and grasping attempts; these are normal nonsexual gameplay adaptations. Empty hands, no gun, dolls, armor, halo, psychic fire or symbols. Athletic adult human proportions, normal practical heel shape, not exaggerated anatomy. ALL TWELVE poses face SCREEN LEFT. This must be an independently authored anatomical view; do not mirror or flip an existing atlas. Sheet A exact poses: Row 1: 0 upright cautious idle with open hands near sides; 1 second idle breathing variation, slightly shifted weight; 2 walking left foot forward; 3 walking transition right foot raised. Row 2: 4 walking right foot forward; 5 walking transition left foot raised; 6 protective unarmed forearm guard near chest; 7 firmer guard braced arms. Row 3: 8 compact crouch bent knees; 9 low crouching guard shorter height but same body scale; 10 small jump ascent with knees bent; 11 jump descent ready to land. Face always points requested direction.
